scoringCalibration: Visual realism is scored independently; passing topology, collision and runtime checks cannot compensate for weak face, hair, clothing or deformation quality.
visualFindings: The face now carries restrained warm cheek, nose and chin variation plus a cooler under-eye zone instead of a nearly uniform tint.
The existing normal texture now feeds through the procedural micro-bump node, so close lighting reveals pore-scale breakup without changing geometry.
Roughness variation is layered over the exportable runtime map and the reduced coat response avoids the former uniformly waxy highlight.
The effect remains subtle and does not hide the broad cheek planes, shallow eyelid integration or simplified mouth topology.
Rejected v22-v24 hair experiments were not merged because regular cards, wide ribbons and a thin fiber veil all scored below the v21 groom from side and rear views.
blockingFailures: The face still needs high-resolution sculpted eyelid, canthus, philtrum, nasolabial and lip-corner transitions.
Skin still needs authored face-specific UV masks for pore direction, oiliness, capillaries, freckles and localized subsurface response.
The groom needs hand-shaped large and medium clumps with a coherent part, dense side/rear coverage and validated alpha cards.
Clothing edge flow, seams, folds, materials and outer layers remain below review quality.
Raised-arm shoulders still require corrective deformation and the pose suite remains incomplete.
Signed clothing-distance samples remain negative despite zero exact triangle overlaps in the two audited frames.
LOD transition popping and frame-time impact remain untested in the website renderer.
